name: Frida Live Instrumentation
author: igwtech
description: Drops Ultimate-ASI-Loader (as dinput8.dll) + frida-gadget (as frida-gadget.asi) into the NC2 game directory. The ASI loader correctly forwards dinput8 exports so the game starts normally, and side-loads frida-gadget.asi at startup — the gadget binds 127.0.0.1:27042 in resume mode and waits for the Python orchestrator at ceres-j/tools/frida_re in the Neocron tree.
